note: Add the new verb as a first-positional command with a single-source synopsis and help entry, and implement upgrade with sha256 verification, atomic replace, skill refresh and --check, taking the fetch route from ADR-0250/ADR-0358 rather than the superseded ADR-0069 §3-4.

Build on the incremental redo-log-cursor validation (ADR-0173 supersedes ADR-0172 §1-2), keeping full recheck, error selection and transaction semantics identical, and honoring catalog-drift rechecks and the smallest-bucket composite probes.

Adding multiple databases conflicts with the fixed-namespace model, so the plan must revise it by a new ADR while keeping the store-level DatabasesCatalog, CE administration commands, USE routing and real SHOW output consistent.

Change the installer's hosting, platforms and invocation as a new ADR superseding ADR-0068 §1-3, while keeping the unauthenticated direct-route download and unchanged integrity chain of ADR-0585, and the release-asset publishing of ADR-0546.

Since ADR-0584 leaves CYPHER 25 as the only version and removes ADR-0513 §1's version stand-down, tighten the same-clause reference rule for all statements while keeping the 22N01 null-binding ruling and the TCK setup re-pin.

Add the event under the CYPHERLITE-CLI_ prefix with no query text, paths or params, and use ADR-0545's local spool plus next-run drain for delivery (superseding ADR-0079 §5) while honoring the opt-out and the ureq/Mixpanel transport.
